title: Transcriptomic atlas reveals organ-specific disease tolerance in sickle cell mice
author: Roumenina, Lubka
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Select and genotype mice
steps.instruction: Genotype all Townes model mice and select age‑ and sex‑matched HbAA (control) and HbSS (sickle cell) littermates that are 6–8 weeks old for the experiment.

steps.title: Anesthetize mice with isoflurane
steps.instruction: Place each mouse under isoflurane anesthesia at 2–3% concentration for all subsequent procedures (injection, blood collection, and sacrifice).

steps.title: Inject hemin or PBS intravenously
steps.instruction: Inject hemin (Ferriprotoporphyrin IX) purchased from Frontiers Scientific into the retro‑orbital sinus at 24 µmol kg⁻¹ intravenously; inject control mice with an equal volume of PBS.

steps.title: Wait then sacrifice mice
steps.instruction: Allow the mice to recover for exactly 4 hours after injection, then sacrifice each mouse by cervical dislocation.

steps.title: Harvest liver and cut sections
steps.instruction: Excise the liver, freeze it, and cut 30 µm‑thick frozen tissue sections as described previously.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue in thioglycerol solution
steps.instruction: Place the frozen sections in 200 µL of 1‑Thioglycerol/Homogenization Solution from the Maxwell® 16 LEV simplyRNA Tissue Kit (Promega, catalog AS1280) and homogenize thoroughly.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality with Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: Extract RNA, then evaluate its quantity and integrity using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with the Agilent RNA 6000 Nano Kit; only samples with RNA Integrity Number (RIN) > 7 proceed to library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare stranded mRNA libraries
steps.instruction: Take 1 µg of high‑quality total RNA (RIN > 7) and construct libraries with the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol: (1) purify poly‑A mRNA, (2) fragment and reverse‑transcribe using random primers, (3) synthesize second strand replacing dTTP with dUTP for strand specificity, (4) add a single A base to cDNA ends, (5) ligate Illumina adapters.

steps.title: Quantify and profile libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify each library by qPCR using the KAPA Library Quantification Kit for Illumina Libraries (KapaBiosystems, Wilmington, MA) and assess library size distribution with DNA High Sensitivity LabChip kits on an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NextSeq 500
steps.instruction: Load the quantified libraries onto an Illumina NextSeq 500 and run a paired‑end 75‑base read (V2 chemistry) sequencing run.

steps.title: Perform primary data analysis
steps.instruction: Process the raw sequencing data with AOZAN software (ENS, Paris) for demultiplexing and quality control, employing FastQC modules (version 0.11.5).

steps.title: Record experimental groups
steps.instruction: The dataset comprises four groups (HbAA PBS, HbAA heme, HbSS PBS, HbSS heme) with four mice per group.
